integrity.claim_scope: The two rational S5-homology representations and the rational cohomology ring of the full orbit space.
integrity.reproducibility: Standalone standard-library exact rational elimination and signed class-character verifier.

scientific_limitations: Only rational S5-modules of the single truncated four-simplex independence complex are determined.
Integral representation lattices and torsion of the orbit space are not determined.
The representation isomorphisms are abstract; no canonical geometric basis is claimed.
Equivalent results in unindexed literature may exist.
title: Rational symmetric-group homology of the truncated four-simplex independence complex
